Imagine a country where, for years, nobody could draft you into an army.
It even opened its own casino!
It was real... and then it vanished from the map.
A tiny triangle of land, born in 1816...
because two kingdoms couldn't agree who owned one zinc mine.
People rushed in. From 256 people... to thousands.
They printed their own stamps, and some even dreamed of an Esperanto state.
Then, in 1920... it was handed to Belgium. Gone. Forever.
